rows.note: Hexoloy SA Form B-1045, opened this check, heads the table Typical Physical Properties. It prints compressive strength 3900 MPa, four-point flexure 380 MPa, Weibull modulus 10, elastic modulus 430 GPa, Poisson 0.14, density 3.10 g/cm3, and flexure bars 3 x 4 x 45 mm. The card scores the inherited 410 GPa and says so. Density matches. The same-bay factors at 430 GPa are recorded and are not a new optimum and not a qualified allowable.

The filed decision leaves qualified Hexoloy SA, CVD SiC and CMC tube compression allowables null. The cited SA figures are typical flexural 380 MPa and typical compression 3900 MPa. Null is not zero strength, and 3.9 GPa is not a qualified tube allowable.

Zero-spare optima do not deduct the sag lift loss already filed on MAINLINE-024: 64.1580396987 kg at s 2.04 m and 94.3500583804 kg at s 3 m. 025 assigns that charge elsewhere. This is not a numerical mismatch.
